best_idea: Quantise each creature's clip time to a fixed rate and cache one pose per (state, quantised time) per model, so poses to build are bounded by clip length rather than by how many creatures are on screen.
decision_why: Keep the bounded per-model cache keyed by (state, quantised time) with a stable per-entity phase offset to avoid lockstep, and skip cross-fades. Reject the parallel build and GPU fold for now: at most 3 attackers per target (MAX_ATTACKERS = 3), so the win is small until zone population (row 23) puts many creatures on screen.
acceptance: A test asserts 40 idle creatures of one model produce at most ceil(30 * clip duration) palette jobs, and a browser frame-time check shows no pose rebuild for creatures in the same bucket; a cross-fading creature gets its own pose.
